chapter: Duke, Gensel and the later years
title: Joe Carroll's death and Europe, 1978-79
summary: Concerts in Copenhagen with Kenny Clarke and Kenny Drew, and Joe Segal's Charlie Parker Month.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: And that continued into the Seventies, didn't it?
Yeah, it continued until Joe died. Joe died about two or three years ago.
Yeah, something like that. I went to Europe in '78, in '77 or '78.
Yeah, with local guys. Well, not too much with local, because Kenny Clarke of course was there, and the bass player, the Jazz at the Philharmonic...
Niels Henning [Orsted-Pedersen], the Danish bass player?
Yeah. And what's the piano player...?
Yeah. We did the album together. But mostly it was just playing, you know, like soloists. So I worked there in '79, '78 through '79 I guess... Then I worked gigs like Chicago and...
Joe Segal. I'd go there on one of his Charlie Parker things.
Every August he has Charlie Parker Month.
